notebook: Turn 57. 49/50 solves used. Best valid = 0.000 (empty design). Summary of everything learned: (1) In this expensive-plant scenario a single tall column (120 stages, reflux 10) costs ~$434M/yr — comparable to or larger than the value of the most valuable pure stream (~$438M/yr n-pentane). So distillation of this feed is essentially break-even at best and negative for any multi-column cascade. (2) Every cascade I built (up to 6 columns, low and high reflux) gave reward between -0.44 and -0.99. (3) Side draws reached only ~65% C5 purity at best, far short of the 95% blend threshold, because adjacent volatilities (isopentane 301 vs n-pentane 309 vs 2,2-dimethylbutane 323) leak into any middle cut. (4) Cheaper/short columns don't separate enough to sell anything pure or as a qualifying blend. Conclusion: with only 1 solve left and all evidence pointing to the empty design (0.000) as my best valid result, I revert to it to lock in a valid score of 0.000 rather than risk another negative plant. No further experiments are worth the risk.
